name: Button
summary: Starts an action or, as a button-link, goes to a page that continues the task.

anatomy.description: The target: at least the minimum target size, padding from the size.
A verb or a destination; never only an icon unless it has an accessible name.
Leading or trailing; the forward arrow turns with the reading direction.

variants.description: The direction's fill: the one main action of a view.
Outline in the direction's colour, text in the page colour .
Underlined text action for minor actions.

cues.disabled: Dashed hollow outline and tertiary text; not colour alone.
cues.pending: Keeps its label, adds a turning mark (dotted and still under reduced motion) and aria-busy; a status region announces the outcome.
cues.focus-visible: The global ring: 2 px outline, 2 px gap, focus.ring colour.

a11y.name: Its text; an icon-only button has aria-label.
notes: Prefer aria-disabled with an explanation over removing a control from the tab order.
A destructive action names what it destroys.

platforms.ios: Button with a ButtonStyle drawing button.* colours
platforms.android: Button, OutlinedButton, TextButton (Material 3 mapped by NDDevTheme)
